subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should plugin `after_compaction` hooks gain a shipped, current-session-only `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` capability across OpenClaw’s compaction runtimes?
rationale: The implementation may be technically sound while still creating a durable plugin API and session-lifecycle policy that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook API
options.body: Accept the after-compaction-only contract after documentation, rebase review, and direct live reset-and-next-turn proof.

options.title: Keep reset policy internal
options.body: Do not expose a plugin method; implement the recovery decision in the owning context engine or core compaction policy.

options.title: Design a broader lifecycle API
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers define a general session-lifecycle capability with explicit permissions and completion semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Accept the after-compaction-only contract after documentation, rebase review, and direct live reset-and-next-turn proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Codex event-projector work and adjacent Codex reset and compaction reports provide the strongest available ownership signal.
